name: browser-use
headline: GitHub Skills: Automation & CI/CD for Claude Code
short_description: Claude Code plugin with GitHub CLI utilities and GitHub Actions workflow generator for automating repetitive GitHub tasks without exposing API keys.
author: JamesPrial

sections.overview:
github-skills provides two integrated skills for GitHub automation within Claude Code: gh-cli for GitHub CLI utilities and github-actions-writer for creating CI/CD workflows. The gh-cli skill includes code search, GitHub Actions error extraction, and GitHub Pages deployment automation. github-actions-writer generates GitHub Actions workflows with built-in best practices and security validation. Since the gh CLI handles authentication, you avoid exposing API keys while automating repetitive GitHub workflows.
Search GitHub for code examples or leaked credentials
Extract error messages from failed GitHub Actions runs
Automate GitHub Pages deployment workflows
Generate GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows for Node.js and other projects
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/JamesPrial/github-skills`
sections.usage:
```
I want to use the GitHub CLI to [ACTION] for my [PROJECT]. Here are the details: [DETAILS]. Can you generate the necessary commands?
```
Copy

```
# GitHub CLI Commands for Project 'OpenSourceApp'
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
